productSummary: TaskFlowLite is a lightweight team task workflow application enabling small teams to manage tasks across TODO/IN_PROGRESS/DONE statuses with JWT-secured authentication, role-based access (ADMIN/MANAGER/MEMBER), team collaboration, task assignment, threaded comments, and full activity audit logging. Built on Spring Boot + PostgreSQL backend with a React + TypeScript (Vite) frontend.

apiContracts.purpose: Register a new user with hashed password
List tasks with filters (status, assignee, unassigned, teamId)
Get task details including comments and activity
Get activity timeline for a task

uiScreens.name: Dashboard
uiScreens.purpose: Show task counts by status and personal overview

uiScreens.name: Task Board
uiScreens.purpose: Kanban-style board with TODO/IN_PROGRESS/DONE columns and filters

uiScreens.name: Task Detail Drawer
uiScreens.purpose: View/edit task with comments and activity timeline tabs

uiScreens.name: Task Create/Edit Modal
uiScreens.purpose: Form to create or edit task fields

uiScreens.name: Teams List
uiScreens.purpose: List user's teams and create new team

uiScreens.name: Team Detail
uiScreens.purpose: Show team members, workload, and team dashboard

uiScreens.name: Navigation Shell
uiScreens.purpose: Responsive layout with sidebar/topbar and auth guard

phases.name: Project Foundation & Tooling
phases.goal: Initialize Spring Boot Maven backend and Vite React TS frontend with PostgreSQL config, base configs, linting, and health endpoint.

phases.name: Database Schema & Migrations
phases.goal: Define PostgreSQL schema and JPA entities for User, Team, TeamMembership, Task, Comment, ActivityLog with Flyway migrations.

phases.name: Authentication, JWT & Password Security
phases.goal: Implement registration, login, BCrypt password hashing, JWT issuance/validation, Spring Security filter chain, and /auth/me profile endpoint.

phases.name: Role-Based Access Control
phases.goal: Implement ADMIN/MANAGER/MEMBER roles, method-level security, and endpoint authorization rules across the API.

phases.name: Task Management Core
phases.goal: Implement CRUD for tasks with title, description, priority, due date, and TODO/IN_PROGRESS/DONE statuses with validation.

phases.name: Team Management & Collaboration
phases.goal: Implement team creation, member invitation/removal, task assignment/reassignment, workload view, and assignee/unassigned filters.

phases.name: Task Comments
phases.goal: Implement add/edit/delete own comments with author and timestamp metadata exposed via API.

phases.name: Activity Audit Logging
phases.goal: Capture activity events for task creation, status/priority/due-date/assignee changes, and comment create/delete; expose timeline API.

phases.name: Dashboards & Reporting
phases.goal: Provide global and team-level dashboards with task counts by status and workload aggregations.

phases.name: Frontend Auth Shell & Routing
phases.goal: Build React app skeleton with login/register pages, JWT storage, auth context, protected routes, and responsive layout.

phases.name: Frontend Task Board & Detail
phases.goal: Build Kanban board, task create/edit modal, task detail drawer with comments and activity timeline tabs, and filters by assignee/unassigned.

phases.name: Frontend Teams & Dashboards
phases.goal: Build teams list, team detail with member management, workload view, and global/team dashboards.

phases.name: Testing & Quality Assurance
phases.goal: Add backend unit/integration tests (JUnit, Testcontainers) and frontend component tests; verify acceptance criteria.

phases.name: Packaging & Delivery
phases.goal: Produce build artifacts, Dockerfiles, env configuration, and README with run instructions for backend and frontend.

acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/health returns 200 with status payload without authentication.
Users can register and log in; passwords are stored as BCrypt hashes; login returns a valid JWT.
GET /api/auth/me returns the authenticated user profile and 401 when no/invalid JWT is supplied.
All task, comment, team, and assignment endpoints reject unauthenticated requests with 401.
ADMIN, MANAGER, and MEMBER roles are enforced; only ADMIN can modify user roles.
Tasks support title, description, priority, due date, and statuses TODO/IN_PROGRESS/DONE with full CRUD.
Only authenticated users can create, update, comment on, or assign tasks.
Teams can be created and members added/removed; tasks can be assigned and reassigned to team members.
Board can be filtered by assignee and can display unassigned tasks.
Per-member workload and team-level dashboard endpoints return accurate aggregates.
Users can add comments and edit/delete only their own comments; comments display author and timestamp.
Activity log records task creation, status/priority/due-date/assignee changes, and comment create/delete events.
Task detail view shows comments and activity timeline.
Global dashboard shows task counts grouped by TODO/IN_PROGRESS/DONE.
Frontend is responsive across desktop and mobile breakpoints.
PostgreSQL schema is provisioned via migrations and data persists across restarts.
Backend and frontend build successfully and run via documented commands.
